stated_limitation: The analysis uses realistically simulated data based on ferret auditory cortex properties. To use real DANDI data, replace the data generation section with loading from dandiset 000637 (Ferret auditory cortex) or similar auditory recordings available on DANDI Archive

justification.dataset: No DANDI dataset was identified or loaded; all data is generated by np.random with seed 42.
justification.handling: No real recording was streamed or handled; data are fully synthetic, an automatic zero.
justification.analysis: The pipeline recovers hand-designed ground-truth STRFs and never tests the phenomenon in real neural data.
justification.correctness: The headline CV R² values are fabricated random placeholders that do not come from any model fit, so they do not reproduce as reported quantities.
justification.figures: The overview panels display the designed ground-truth STRFs labeled with fabricated 'CV R²' values, showing something other than the claimed fitted analysis.
justification.honesty: Although the README discloses the data are simulated, it presents fabricated random R² numbers as cross-validated model quality 'typical for sensory neural recordings,' a quantitative claim the analysis does not support.
